notes.title: Performance & Stability Update for Worldsmith and Jump King
notes.content:
The main focus in this update is to bring [b]general performance[/b] and [b]stability issues[/b] related to Worldsmith to make the process of making your custom content less slow and more enjoyable!

[h2]Worldsmith[/h2]
[h3]Quality of Life additions[/h3]

[*]  Improvements on how "Load an existing folder" prompt works: 
      [list]
      [*] Added a new checkbox to determine which folder to load from (Worldsmith's default or custom).
      [*] The prompt will not display if the folder does not exists.
      [*] Fixed a bug where writing the title of the loaded item BEFORE the item name would cause the folder directory to be changed.
      [/list]
[*] Improvements on how "Start position" works:
      [list]
      [*] Fixed a bug where the start position would not save changes. [i](thanks to Czar!)[/i]
      [*] Moved start position from the Item Details page to the Screens page for ease of use and overall better experience; the position inside of the Screens page will be relative rather than the final value (that is absolute).
      [*] You can now visually see the start position inside of the Screens page.
      [/list]
[*] Improvements on how babes and their ending images works:
      [list]
      [*] Revamped slighly how the UI looks in the ending details expanders.
      [*] Moved babe screens from the Item Details page to the Screens page for ease of use and overall better experience.
      [*] Fixed a bug where changing any babe screens would not save changes.
      [*] Fixed a bug where changing ending images would not save changes.
      [*] You can now add, move and/or remove a babe directly in the screen page.
      [/list]
[*] New awesome Worldsmith icon!
[*] Minor improvements with scrolling images over performance.

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed freezes and crashes related a lot of sprites in one screen.
[*] Fixed level flags not changing on file when adding or removing. [i](thanks to Cloudy & Czar!)[/i]
[*] Fixed a crash when loading a different project. [i](thanks to IntroCar!)[/i]
[*] Fixed Hidden Walls sizing and scrolling image previews crashing if the velocity is set to 0.
[*] Fixed custom Wardrobe base not loading on first load.
[*] Fixed position offset of scrolling images.
[*] Fixed velocity calculations of scrolling images.
[*] Fixed static animations for scrolling images (without using floats).
[*] Fixed hidden walls not displaying correctly in Screen page.
[*] Fixed Worldsmith versioning in settings.
[*] Fixed an internal bug where the item settings would save recursively.
[*] Fixed a crash when trying to go up/down a screen in the Screen page. [i](thanks to Czar!)[/i]
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn't add the same prop twice. [i](thanks to Czar!)[/i]
[*] Fixed a bug where the taskbar would display with a progress bar all the time after building content. (green background bar on windows 10, long progress bar on windows 11)
[*] Fixed a bug where a prompt issue dismisses a previously opened prompt
[*] Removed some unused assets.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Jump King[/h2]
This update brings:

[list]
[*] Everything inside of the game will now update when clicking the update button in the debug mode.
[*] In debug mode, a new option to disable all labels when testing.
[/list]

notes.title: Tileset Update
notes.content:
[h2]Worldsmith [BETA][/h2]
What's new:
[list]
[*] [b]Tilesets[/b]! You can now create, modify and publish your tilesets or use already existing ones from the community to easily create screen details!
[*] [b]Full mod support[/b]! You can now use Worldsmith to create, manage and debug your new and old mods with ease!
[*] [b]Project linking[/b]! With this highly requested feature, you can now link a local project (on your computer) to modify and/or update an already existing Steam Workshop item!
[*] [b]Quality of life improvements[/b]! Worldsmith loads projects 70-80% faster compared to the last build, you can now also see Jump King blog updates from inside Worldsmith and the preview screen is now resizable.
[*] Added the ability to add props, hidden wall props, scrolling images, world items, NPCs, merchants, messages and sounds onto a screen.
[/list]

This update fixes:
[list]
[*] A bug where a mask would not correctly save.
[*] A bug where the wardrobe settings would be wiped.
[*] A bug where props could not be created.
[*] A bug where skin sets would be missing the base skin.
[*] A bug where one or more props on a screen would delete itself.
[/list]

[h3]Get started with the Workshop: [url=https://teamnexile.github.io/jk-workshop-docs/][b]https://teamnexile.github.io/jk-workshop-docs/[/b][/url][/h3]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Jump King[/h2]
This update fixes:
[list]
[*] A bug where the white raven's position would skip ahead by default. 
     [b]WARNING! Custom maps that depended on skipping the white bird's placement to prevent this bug, will need to fix their white raven's placement by removing those empty slots.[/b]
[*] A bug where mods were not considered when creating the workshop menu.
[*] A bug where Jump King would uninstall tilesets on start-up.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Workshop documentation[/h2]
The documentation has been [b]updated to hold the new Worldsmith changes[/b] such as [b]new sections, in-depth how-tos and pages for tilesets and mods[/b]. Read the [url=https://teamnexile.github.io/jk-workshop-docs/]documentation's changelog[/url].

notes.title: STEAM WORKSHOP UPDATE - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=cVrtQVJJouk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Workshop Update[/h1]

You can now access a plethora of skins and levels on Steam Workshop! Accessing mods to the game has been made easier than ever. Not only is the mods easy for the user, but also the creator! 

For more in depth information on how modding Jump King has been made easier [url=https://www.jump-king.com/steam-workshop-update]READ HERE[/url] 

[h2]Jump King Workshop[/h2]
You will now find the workshop tab under the Jump King game. It features our own tags to sort content which is mainly 3 categories:
- Levels 
- Skins
- Mods (Gameplay/UI/etc altering types of mods)

Subscribing to content can be done both in the Steam Application itself as well as through the In-Game menu in Jump King. You can keep your game open as you download new workshop content and simply load the update by clicking ESC (to refresh) within the main menu.

[h2]Worldsmith[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2245910/
In your library under tools (or if you search Jump King in the search-bar) you can find "Jump King Worldsmith [BETA]". It is a brand new tool we are working on to make modding Jump King as easy as possible. Right now it features preview-screens of the skin/level project you are working on as well as live-updates of your hitboxes [b]even while testing it in-game![b] Check it out and see what you can make with it!

By the way! We also introduced a new Korean localisation!

For direct community engagement, join our [url=discord.com/invite/jumpking]DISCORD[/url]


[b]IMPORTANT:[/b]
- [b]OLD MODS[/b] may not be compatible with the game anymore. Though they may come to the workshop in the future (if the creator wishes to adapt it/convert it)
- [b]TO PLAY AN OLDER VERSION OF THE GAME:[/b] Go to Library->Jump King->Right Click Properties->Betas and opt into the "jump_king_legacy" branch.
- [b]Jump King Plus[/b] is NOT compatible with the new build
- [b]If your custom map does not work[/b], try reinstalling it or restarting the game, alternatively check if you have subscribed to JumpKingPlus Blocks on the workshop (if a mechanic is not working)
- [b]If you have feedback and/or bug reports feel please fill in this [url=https://forms.gle/7o6tvytjZ7VMexbK6]Feedback Form[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Entire new world in upcoming free expansion New Babe+ for Jump King!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34828984/804c1d93ea9a92367015654e34cfd85f661a3019.jpg[/img]

[h1]We are bringing New Babe+ to Jump King in June, together with our first-ever sale! Also: Jump King Original Soundtrack available now![/h1]

[b]We are working on an expansive addition to Jump King, we call it “New Babe+” and it will release on June 7th. At the launch of New Babe+ we will also run the first sale of Jump King, at a 30% discount! While you wait for the expansion listen to the OST for Jump King – it just released![/b]

After completing the challenge of the original game you should have had the practice needed to face the true ordeal of New Babe+… The expansion features an entirely new level both greater in length and skill-requirement than the original! In this definitive conclusion to Jump King you will get to prove yourself truly worthy of the title Jump King!

New Babe+ includes more elements of fantasy compared to the original – set in a secret world reached through a hidden path. You will encounter even more mystical characters and locations, in addition to more items to obtain and achievements to master. To top it off the new expansion will be complete with a new soundtrack, this time featuring more cinematic and melodic arrangements!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I2TQydgdoe4

New Babe+ will release as a free expansion on June 7th along with our first sale for Jump King at 30% off!

[list]
[*]     With New Babe+ the total content of Jump King is more than doubled
[*]     The secret level can be accessed immediately at “New Game” – if you find the way
[*]     The launch of New Babe+ will be accompanied by a 30% sale
